update environment configuration and task management for Cloudflare integration, including new scripts for D1 migrations, R2 uploads, and enhanced README documentation for local and production setups
enhance POS UI components and styles for improved layout and usability, including responsive adjustments, padding updates, and currency formatting changes across various components
enhance product image handling by adding versioning support in file URL generation and implementing cache refresh logic for improved image updates
update font configurations in Nuxt and CSS files, replacing "Fraunces" with "Noto Sans Thai" for improved typography consistency across the application

implement soft delete functionality across various entities, including promotions, products, and customers, with corresponding database schema updates, route modifications, and integration tests to ensure proper handling of deleted records
implement member role management feature, allowing store owners to change member roles with validation and audit logging, along with UI updates for roles and permissions settings
update UI components and styles for improved consistency and usability, including Tailwind CSS integration, modal enhancements, and responsive design adjustments across various components
add comprehensive testing framework for backend and frontend, including unit, integration, and E2E tests, along with CI configuration for automated testing

implement promotions feature including promotion creation, validation, and application logic, along with database schema updates and UI enhancements for managing promotions in the cart and order processes
enhance file upload handling by ensuring upload directories are created and improving image upload validation with logging for better error tracking
add category deletion validation to prevent deletion of categories with associated products, including user feedback and error handling
add mobile navigation and data display components for improved user experience in POS and dashboard views
implement service worker for enhanced PWA offline capabilities, including custom offline page and caching strategies for API responses
enhance PWA configuration by adding prerendering for locale JSON, improving offline cold start, and optimizing caching strategies
implement backup and restore functionality with scripts for creating and managing backups, including integration with Google Drive for storage and automated Jenkins pipeline for scheduled backups
refactor sidebar and header components to utilize useSidebar composable for improved state management and code clarity
implement password reset functionality including email notifications, token validation, and user interface updates for improved user experience
add reporting features including report generation and export functionality, implement bulk product import with validation, and enhance product management UI for improved user experience

enhance user interface by updating viewport settings for better mobile compatibility, adding touch-action utilities for improved touch interactions, and applying consistent touch handling across CartPanel, MobileCartBar, and POS pages
implement mobile cart components including CartPanel, MobileCartBar, and MobileCartSheet for improved user experience on mobile devices
add PWA installation support with install banner, configuration updates, and localization for enhanced user experience
implement PromptPay QR payment integration, including modal for QR display, validation of PromptPay ID, and settings management in the store configuration
add AppDialog component for enhanced user interactions, implement dialog management with useDialog composable, and update various pages to utilize confirmation and alert dialogs
implement stock management enhancements for order processing, including inventory validation, insufficient stock handling, and improved user feedback in the POS interface
implement audit logging system for tracking changes across various entities, including orders, products, customers, and discounts, enhancing traceability and accountability in the application
enhance logging capabilities across backend and frontend, introduce log level configuration, and implement structured logging for better debugging and monitoring
implement product image upload and management system, including validation, caching, and synchronization with the backend
add API endpoint to retrieve team members for a store and update frontend to use the new endpoint
implement store member invitation system with email and direct addition modes, update environment variables, and enhance UI for managing invites
remove card payment method from the application, update related components and localization files
integrate i18n support for localization, add language switcher component, and update UI elements for multi-language support
enhance deployment setup with GitHub Actions for CI/CD, add self-hosted runner configuration, and update environment variable documentation
implement store member rules migration and enhance store fetching logic with error handling
add Taskfile and development workflow documentation for local, dev, and prod environments
add initial project structure with Docker configurations, environment variables, and basic README for zKCNT POS system
improve authentication handling in routing by consolidating checks for user authentication status
implement sale screen and enhance side menu navigation with route management
rename qms-web to pos-web in docker-compose and update Dockerfile for drift integration
add logging to AuthNotifier initialization and authentication check
add Cache-Control header to Nginx configuration for improved caching behavior
integrate AuthNotifier into routing configuration for improved authentication handling
update user authentication handling and improve side menu user info management
enhance side menu with POS functionality and user role management
add side menu and routing functionality with localization support
add responsive design support and logging for sign-up process
add Nginx configuration for serving Flutter web app and update manifest for zKCNT POS
implement user authentication with sign-in functionality and local storage management
enhance sign-up response by including user and store details in the success response
implement sign-up functionality with validation and error handling, update login route to GET
เตรียมหน้าสำหรับสมัครสมาชิก
implement user sign-up functionality with PocketBase integration and localization support
restructure frontend for zKCNT POS application with localization and routing support
init backend with pocketbase
